metadata.content:
*You conjure an angel who moves a foe and heals your allies.*

| **Magic, [Ranged](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/ranged), [Strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/strike)**  |               **[Main action](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn)** |
|----------------------------|------------------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/ranged) 10**           | **🎯 One creature or object** |

**[Power Roll](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/power-roll) + [Intuition](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/intuition):**

- **≤11:** 9 + I holy damage; [slide](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) 3
- **12-16:** 13 + I holy damage; [slide](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) 4
- **17+:** 18 + I holy damage; [slide](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) 6

**Effect:** Each ally the target comes [adjacent](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/adjacent) to during the [forced movement](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) can spend a [Recovery](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/recoveries).
